<style>.viafoura {
  --primary-font: 'AP', sans-serif;
  --x-large-font: 3.2; /* 32px changes the large title at top */
  --large-font: 2.0;   /* 20px NOT changing anything*/
  --medium-font: 1.6;  /* 16px changes the headline font in active conversations*/
  --small-font: 1.8;   /* 18px NOT changing anything*/
  --x-small-font: 1.0; /* 10px the small font as the reply to user*/
}

.vf-comment-header {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  width: 100%;
}
/* Hide just the floating bell, everywhere */
vf-tray-trigger[floating],
.vf-tray-trigger--floating {
  display: none !important;
}
.vf-comment-header__heading {
  flex: 1 1 auto !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  font-size: 1.2em;
}

.vf-comment-header__actions {
  flex: 0 0 auto !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px;
}

.vf-comment-header__actions > * {
  flex: 0 0 auto !important;
}
/* Hide the Profile button/tab in Viafoura comments module */
#vf-tray > div > div > div > div > article > nav > div.vf-horiz-list.vf-tabbed-nav__tabs.vf-flex-grow > div:nth-child(2) {
    display: none;
}
button[data-test="vf-tray-tab-settings"] {
    display: none !important;
}

/* this hides the second start the conversation text in the empty comments area of the below article module */
.vf-ad-empty-comments {
    display: none !important;
}
/* this hides the email sign in the user profile in the tray*/
.vf-client-settings-email-notifications {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Hide the Settings button in Viafoura comments module */
.vf-tray-settings-button,
span.vf-tray-settings-button,
button.vf-tray-settings-button {
    display: none !important;
}

#ap-comments .vf-follow-button {
  display: none !important;
}

.viafoura .vf-badge--accent-color[data-v-2c5d8df2].vf-custom-badge {
   background-color:#ff322e !important;
}
